# useSSE

> Subscribe to Server-Sent Events with EventSource: named events, history and clean shutdown.

🟡 intermediate · React 18.0+ · Custom Hooks › Data fetching & async · support: browser-limited

**Playground:** `npm run dev` → [`#/entry/use-sse`](http://localhost:5173/#/entry/use-sse)

## Concept

Creates an `EventSource` in an effect, listens to the given event types, parses each message and keeps a bounded history. Status mirrors `readyState`: the browser retries by itself (`connecting`) unless the failure is fatal (`closed`).

## Problem

Forgetting to `close()` keeps streams (and server connections) open after navigation; named events need explicit listeners; fatal vs retrying errors look the same in `onerror`.

## When to use

- One-way live updates over HTTP: notifications, progress, logs, prices.

## When not to use

- The client must send messages — use `useWebSocket`.
- You need custom headers (e.g. `Authorization`) — `EventSource` cannot set them; use `fetch` streaming.

## API

```ts
function useSSE<T = unknown>(
  url: string | null,
  options?: {
    eventTypes?: readonly string[];
    withCredentials?: boolean;
    parse?: (data: string, type: string) => T;
    historyLimit?: number;
    onMessage?;
    onError?;
  },
): {
  isSupported: boolean;
  status: 'connecting' | 'open' | 'closed';
  lastMessage;
  messages;
  close: () => void;
  reconnect: () => void;
};
```

| Parameter                 | Type                | Description                                      |
| ------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `url`                     | `string \| null`    | `null` closes the stream.                        |
| `eventTypes` _(optional)_ | `readonly string[]` | Default `["message"]`; add named `event:` types. |
| `parse` _(optional)_      | `(data, type) => T` | Default JSON with raw-string fallback.           |

**Returns:** Support flag, status, messages (`{ type, data, lastEventId }`), stable `close` and `reconnect`.

## Execution flow

1. Effect: `new EventSource(url, { withCredentials })` and listeners for `open`, `error` and each event type.
2. Error: `readyState` CONNECTING → `connecting` (browser retries); CLOSED → `closed` (fatal).
3. Cleanup: listeners removed and `close()` called — no late updates.

## Edge cases

- When the server ends the stream normally, browsers reconnect after the `retry:` delay and send `Last-Event-ID`.
- HTTP/1.1 limits browsers to ~6 connections per origin, including SSE streams.

## Browser support

Feature-detects `EventSource` (`isSupported`). The mock `/api/events` exists only in browsers.

## Testing

jsdom has no EventSource, so tests install a small fake with `vi.stubGlobal`: open, JSON messages, named events, history limit, retry vs fatal errors, reconnect, close and URL changes.

## Production considerations

- Serve SSE over HTTP/2 to avoid the per-origin connection limit.
